title: Talking Pixels Platform Open and Live : Create games, find teams with dev tools/features, publish your game and just finished our Launcher for everyone. All for free.
author: TalkingPixelsStudio
selftext:
Morning/evening all,

After years of planning, development, testing, and plenty of late nights, (plenty is understated xD) I’m excited to announce that **Talking Pixels is officially live for everyone!**

[https://www.talkingpixels.games](https://www.talkingpixels.games/)

My goal was ambitious: **Build a platform where anyone can create, share, discover, play, and publish games, whether they’re experienced developers or just getting started. (and I kept adding things xD)**

But Talking Pixels isn’t just another game builder or marketplace.

I've built an interconnected ecosystem for developers, gamers, artists, and creators, with an emphasis on accessibility and making game development easier for everyone.

**A game launcher built for gamers**

I'm also launching the **Talking Pixels Game Launcher (hopefully within the next few hours)**, a desktop client designed to bring your gaming library together.

* **One gaming library:** Organize games from Talking Pixels and games acquired elsewhere.
* **Enhanced controller accessibility:** Controller support designed to help disabled gamers enjoy more games with fewer barriers.
* **A more inclusive gaming experience:** Invite friends, start groups and battle your companions in a social arena. ( More on this soon...I got a little carried away)
* **Game discovery:** Explore games and connect with the creators behind them.
* Publish your games right to talking pixels via Godot and our game builder plugin. It will be put on the launcher store and cross posted all at once.
* Linux Friendly

I believe accessibility shouldn’t be an afterthought. It should be part of how gaming platforms are designed from the beginning.

**Game development without unnecessary barriers**

Want to create your own game but don’t know how to code?

Talking Pixels offers free game development resources and templates to help aspiring developers get started. Started templates and an easy to use game builder built right into the Godot engine. More engines will be supported in the future.

Whether you’re making an RPG, fighting game, or something entirely different, I wanted to make the journey from idea to playable game less intimidating.

**A marketplace for indie creators**

Developers can publish games, while artists and other creators can share or sell their work.

**Our platform fee is just 10% on paid sales, plus payment processing costs. (Right now everything is free as I gather community feedback).**

Joining the platform and publishing free content is free. I don't want to get rich from this, money isn't important like that to me. I would like to eventually be able to provide stable jobs to others who share my vision for the platform and lower the costs as much as possible to make sure you get everything you deserve from your work.

**More than a game builder**

Talking Pixels also includes community features that let you:

* Share your projects and development progress.
* Connect with developers, artists, musicians, and gamers.
* Create and join groups.
* Discover projects and creators.
* Participate in achievements and community activities.
* Explore development tools, learning resources, and AI assistance.

We want developers to have more than a storefront. We want them to have a community and the tools to build something meaningful.

**Why I did this**

There are incredibly talented people who never get the chance to make their games.

Some lack programming knowledge. Others don’t have a team, financial resources, or a place to find collaborators.

And for gamers with disabilities, even getting a game to work comfortably with their preferred controller can be a challenge.

**We want to help remove those barriers.**

Talking Pixels is was my dream job/project and an attempt to bring more of the gaming and development experience together in one place. With a Team Finder and tools in each users dashboard to manage and keep yourself (and maybe your team) on process and meet the goals/deadlines you have and it grew more from there.

**Check it out - I would love the feedback <3**

I'm officially welcoming developers, gamers, artists, asset creators, and anyone interested in making or playing games to signup and imagine what it could become with community feedback. Anything else you guys need/want added, changed etc etc will be read by me and, once I get a small team, I will be implementing a community board that will help shape the future of Talking Pixels so the community always has a say in what happens.

Someone could come and offer me a billion dollars for everything and I would turn it down. Most say that and I get it...but I'll say it and prove it if an offer is ever made.

This is only the beginning, and I would genuinely appreciate feedback as I continue to improve the platform.

**What would you want from a platform built around both game development and gaming accessibility?**

[**https://www.talkingpixels.games**](https://www.talkingpixels.games/)

Post on the social feed if you join Talking Pixels and I'll gift you with a limited time badge and other items for your player profile.

You can find the builder and launcher installers on the platform now and everything integrates seamleslly. You can even publish your games to the platform and launcher right from godot (other engines coming soon).

**Que notatallcorny catch-phase - Create. Connect. Play.**

Feel free to reach out here or on the platform and I'll respond asap. Thanks for everything this sub has taught me throughout the years and sorry for taking so long. I jumped the gun a few times and thought I was ready for launch and got humbled. Now I'm confident. :)
